title: Omarketing OutputLocator v1
description: Server-validated locator for one existing ComfyUI output.
$comment: All locator primitives are persisted independently. Implementations must not construct, parse, or trust a frontend synthetic AssetItem.id. The server recomputes sha256, size_bytes, and mime_type from the contained output file before accepting the locator.

job_id.$comment: The backend job/prompt identifier is stored directly, never recovered from a frontend asset identifier.

node_id.$comment: ComfyUI node identifiers are serialized as strings, including when their lexical value contains only digits.

subfolder.$comment: Relative to the configured ComfyUI output root. Absolute paths, backslashes, empty segments, dot segments, parent traversal, and control characters are forbidden; the server must additionally resolve the path and enforce output-root containment.

filename.$comment: A basename only. Directory separators, dot entries, and control characters are forbidden.

sha256.$comment: Lowercase SHA-256 recomputed by the server from the selected output bytes.

size_bytes.$comment: Nonnegative byte length recomputed by the server.

mime_type.$comment: Canonical lowercase media type without parameters, determined by the server from the output.

asset_id.$comment: Optional backend-issued enrichment only. It is not a frontend synthetic AssetItem.id and is never required to resolve the output.
